title: AmaraSpatial-10K: A Spatially and Semantically Aligned 3D Dataset for Spatial Computing and Embodied AI
abstract: arXiv:2604.23018v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Web-scale 3D asset collections are abundant but rarely ready to ingest without cleanup, suffering from arbitrary metric scaling, incorrect pivots, brittle geometry, and incomplete textures, defects that limit their use in embodied AI, robotics, and spatial computing. We present AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of 10,071 synthetic 3D assets standardised for direct ingestion. Each asset ships as a metric-scaled, deterministically anchored .glb with separated PBR maps, a convex collision hull, a paired reference image, and multi-sentence text metadata. Alongside the dataset we introduce a reusable evaluation suite for 3D asset banks, a continuous Scale Plausibility Score (SPS), a keyword-based Concept Density metric, anchor-error auditing, and a cross-modal CLIP coherence protocol, and apply it to AmaraSpatial-10K alongside matched subsets of Objaverse, HSSD, ABO, and GSO. We check the annotations independently of the LLM/VLM pipeline

translated_title: AmaraSpatial-10K：一个面向空间计算与具身智能的空间与语义对齐3D数据集
translated_abstract: 网络规模的3D资产资源库虽然数量庞大，但很少能够不经清理就直接使用，它们普遍存在度量尺度随意、轴心点错误、几何结构脆弱以及纹理不完整等缺陷，这些缺陷限制了它们在具身智能、机器人和空间计算中的应用。我们提出了AmaraSpatial-10K，一个包含10,071个标准化合成3D资产、可直接导入使用的数据集。每个资产均以度量尺度标准化、确定性锚定的.glb格式提供，附带分离的PBR贴图、凸包碰撞体、配套参考图像以及多句子文本元数据。除数据集外，我们还引入了一套可复用的3D资产库评估套件，包括连续的尺度合理性评分（SPS）、基于关键词的概念密度指标、锚点误差审计以及跨模态CLIP一致性协议，并将其应用于AmaraSpatial-10K以及Objaverse、HSSD、ABO和GSO的匹配子集。我们对标注进行了独立于LLM/VLM流程的验证。
tldr: 该论文发布了包含10,071个经过度量尺度标准化、确定性锚定并附带完整材质与语义标注的3D资产数据集AmaraSpatial-10K，并配套提出了一套可复用的3D资产质量评估套件，为空间计算与具身智能提供了可直接使用的高质量3D资源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of 10,071 metric-scaled, deterministically anchored 3D assets with complete materials and semantic annotations, along with a reusable evaluation suite for 3D asset banks, providing directly ingestible high-quality 3D resources for spatial computing and embodied AI.
